user.title: Radar Occupancy
user.description: What do you want to add?

menu_options.plan: Floor plan image (map without a robot vacuum)

room.title: Add room
room.description: Choose the radar device of this room; its sensors are suggested in the next step. Without a device you pick them yourself. The name defaults to the device's area.

area.title: Add sub-area
area.description: A rectangle in the radar coordinates of the room sensor. Disappearing here never counts as leaving the room.

home.title: Add home
home.description: One per installation. Holds the master switch of the light automation, map mode with people counting on robot vacuum maps, fade times and the overview for the position card.

plan.title: Add floor plan
plan.description: An image of one floor as map for map mode, for homes without a supported robot vacuum map. Put a PNG or JPEG file into the www folder of your configuration and give its path below it, e.g. floorplans/ground.png. Room outlines and doors are drawn on the position card afterwards.

data.name: Name
data.image_width: Real width of the whole image

data_description.image: Path inside the www folder, e.g. floorplans/ground.png.
data_description.image_width: Measure a wall shown on the plan and scale it to the full image width.

room_inputs.title: Sensors of {room}
room_inputs.description: {found} sensors were suggested from the device; check them. Presence is required. Distance of target 1 is needed for the door range, X/Y for sub-areas, X/Y of all targets for map mode.

error.plan_image: The image cannot be read. It must be a PNG or JPEG file inside the www folder of your configuration.
error.name_required: Give a name or choose a device.

abort.already_configured: The home is already set up.

data.safety_timeout: Release after no presence for (0 = never)
data.handover_anywhere: Hand over even when lost away from the door
data.takeover_min: Take over only from this distance
data.window_end: Time window to (same as start = always)

data_description.door_from: The room is left only if the target disappears in this distance range. 0 to 0 means every disappearance counts as leaving.
data_description.handover: Single-person household only: when this room lost its target and another taking part room sees someone, this room is free.
data_description.takeover_min: Ignore targets of this room's sensor that are closer, e.g. a fixed echo from a door leaf.
data_description.run_on: Delay after the room became free.
data_description.map_camera: Map mode: the map of this floor, either the saved map of a robot vacuum (dreame_vacuum camera) or a floor plan entry. Calibrate the sensor on the position card.
data_description.map_room: The segment of the robot map that is this room.
data_description.door_rooms: Map rooms reachable through a real door. Empty: every adjacent map room. Map rooms without a radar count as outside.
data_description.remember_brightness: Fade to the brightness last set by hand instead of the fixed brightness.

data.manual_off_reset: Switched off by hand ends after the room was empty for

data_description.manual_off_reset: A light switched off by hand in an occupied room stays off, also after leaving briefly. 0: only until the next entering.
data_description.approach_brightness: Share of the target brightness while someone walks towards the room (map mode).

data.image_width: Real width of the whole image

data_description.image: Path inside the www folder, e.g. floorplans/ground.png.
data_description.image_width: Measure a wall shown on the plan and scale it to the full image width.

error.plan_image: The image cannot be read. It must be a PNG or JPEG file inside the www folder of your configuration.

target_present.message: A target is present; only a held occupancy can be released.

leave_first.message: Walk out through the door first, then press.

no_distance.message: No distance seen yet; a distance entity is required.

no_home.message: Set up the home (map mode) first.

exit_point.message: An exit needs X and Y, or clear.

no_map_camera.message: Choose a robot map for this room first (Configure).

map_not_loaded.message: The map is not loaded yet; reload the maps.

map_replaced.message: The map was replaced. Reset the calibration of this sensor first.

one_target.message: Exactly one fresh radar target must be visible for a sample. Move a little.

sample_too_close.message: This sample is only {cm} cm from a stored radar or map point. Move about 1 m and tap your actual position there. Not saved.

too_many_samples.message: At most twelve samples; reset to start over.

place_first.message: Place the sensor on the current map first.

calibrate_first.message: Calibrate first, or place and orient the sensor.

samples_collinear.message: The calibration points are too close together or on one line.

samples_too_few.message: At least three spread-out calibration points are needed.

samples_flat.message: The calibration points form a triangle that is too small or too flat. Step sideways out of the line of the previous points, about 1 m. The new point was not saved.

samples_inconsistent.message: The calibration points disagree by more than 40 cm; please measure them again.

outline_crossing.message: The outline must not cross itself.

door_point.message: A door needs the room behind it and a map point.

door_same_room.message: A door must lead to another room or outside.

plan_image.message: The image cannot be read. It must be a PNG or JPEG file inside the www folder of your configuration.
